The lore "Hoth hath no fury like a Wookiee scorned" plays on "Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned." William Congreve wrote in ''[https://archive.org/details/mourningbridetra00cong The Mourning Bride]'' (1697): "Heav'n has no Rage, like Love to Hatred turn'd, / Nor Hell a Fury, like a Woman scorn'd."
